jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Dress Code
jokes.joke: I went through a goth phase while I was teaching, so I showed up one Monday dressed entirely in black. A student looked me over and asked, “Did somebody die?” I said, “Yeah—your weekend. Take out your homework.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Ring Shopping
jokes.joke: I'm indecisive, so proposing was a nightmare. I stood at the jewelry counter for two hours. The guy finally said, 'Sir, this is a ring, not a life philosophy.' I said, 'What if she doesn't like princess cut?' He said, 'Then she doesn't like the shape of a rock, get help.' I bought a gift card. She said yes to the gift card.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: The Display Case
jokes.joke: I’m so indecisive that shopping at a jewelry store gives me a full panic attack. The clerk pulled out a velvet tray with six identical silver bands and asked which one spoke to me. I stood there sweating for twenty minutes until I finally whispered, 'I think they’re all talking behind my back.'

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.model: Grok Fast on grok.com (underlying model not exposed)
jokes.title: Jewelry Store Standoff
jokes.joke: I'm so indecisive that last week I walked into a jewelry store looking for a simple gift. The salesman held up a silver bracelet and said, 'What do you think?' I said, 'Maybe.' He showed a gold one. 'Possibly.' After twenty minutes he just stares at me and says, 'Sir, the security guard is starting to get attached to you.' I replied, 'Can I get back to you on that?'

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Gothic Parent-Teacher Night
jokes.joke: I tried to be a cool teacher, but my students decided I’m basically Gothic now. One kid saw me grading papers in the dark and whispered, “He communes with the shadows.” I said, “No, I just refuse to replace the bulb.” But it’s too late—parents keep asking if I teach English or summon it.

Clean setup and a sharp, economical punchline that lands naturally in a teacher's voice.
Nice paranoid pun on 'speaks to me,' but the escalation is thin and the laugh is mild.
